title: Ordinary finite-coefficient external direct-image product
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use ordinary unbounded derived constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], and the canonical operations $La^*\dashv Ra_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For a scheme morphism $a:U\to W$, $K\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $L\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, let $\pi_{a,K,L}:Ra_*K\otimes_A^L L\to Ra_*(K\otimes_A^L La^*L)$ be the component of the counit-defined ordinary projection map [def-exchange-projection]. Let $a:U\to B$, $b:V\to B$ be morphisms of schemes and let $T$, with $r:T\to U$ and $t:T\to V$, be any fibre-product cone [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $w=bt=ar$. For arbitrary $H\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $J\in D(V_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ put $F=Ra_*H$ and $G=Rb_*J$. Using the signed swap $\sigma$ [def-pur-finite-forward-tensor-symmetry], the counit-defined exchange $E=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,a,b,H}:Lb^*F\to Rt_*Lr^*H$ [def-exchange-projection], and the canonical compositor $c_{b,t}:Rw_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rb_*Rt_*$ [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition], define
$$\Omega_{a,b}(H,J)=c_{b,t}^{-1}\circ Rb_*(\pi_{t,Lr^*H,J})\circ Rb_*(E\otimes1_J)\circ Rb_*(\sigma_{J,Lb^*F})\circ\pi_{b,J,F}\circ\sigma_{F,G}.$$
Its source is $F\otimes_A^L G$ and its target is $Rw_*(Lr^*H\otimes_A^L Lt^*J)$. The construction uses no inverse exchange or projection, and places no properness, boundedness, constructibility, compactifiability or exceptional-adjoint condition on the maps or objects.

lean.statement:
def finiteProductOrdinary {U V T : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ B) (b : V ⟶ B)
    {r : T ⟶ U} {t : T ⟶ V} (sq : IsPullback r t a b)
    (H : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (J : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology V) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B).obj
      (R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a).obj H)).obj
      (R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b).obj J) ⟶
    R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (t ≫ b)).obj
      (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (T)).obj
        (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (r)).obj H)).obj
        (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (t)).obj J))
